**Needs changes before merge** — one body fix. The code, tests and law checks are clean.

## What looks good

- `tab_clear::level_start` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/tab_clear.rs:49-60`) returns the untabbed seat unchanged on a degenerate fit or a non-finite length, so a bad fit never moves the seam and never panics.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour.rs:166` keeps the old seam where two rings or two bands share a level (`lad.walks`) or in a fence band (`band.room`). That is the crossing-law exception, and `contour_whole_step` stays green.
- The fix moves only the seam of the untabbed levels of a tabbed loop. A picked start, a contour without tabs and a ring without a tabbed level do not change (`contour.rs:165-167`).
- The catalog case `2d/contour-tabs` is regenerated and the committed `.nc` matches the new path. No golden moved. No snapshot PNG changed. No new dependency. No `build.rs`, `.github/`, script or process file changed.
- `docs/decisions/3453-tabbed-contour-entry.md` records the decision, the exception and the dropped options.

## Results (merged with main `10a0a39c0`, locally, `-j 3`)

The trial merge with `origin/main` is clean. No conflict.

- motion lib: 573 passed, 0 failed, 10 ignored.
- `contour_tab_entry`: 3 passed.
- `contour_auto_side` 6, `contour_inside_ramp` 2, `contour_outside_floor` 2, `contour_start` 21, `contour_start_comp` 5, `contour_tab_bridge` 9, `contour_tab_height` 10, `contour_tab_lead` 2, `contour_tab_necks` 13, `contour_tabs` 5, `contour_whole` 8, `contour_whole_new_outline` 6, `contour_whole_no_floor` 2, `control_comp` 8, `lead_room` 4 (1 ignored, pre-existing), `machining2d` 68, `pass_start_levels` 7. All pass.
- app: `conformance` 7, `contour_whole_step` 3, `first_part_programs` 2, `golden_cl` 34, `example_catalog` 39 passed and 4 ignored. All pass.
- clippy `-p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`): green. 2 twins, `motion light: lib` and `motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel`. Release build 260 s.
- No heavy lane: `P3`, #3558.

## Targeted tests

- `example_catalog` rebuilds and posts every case, so the changed `examples/catalog/2d/contour-tabs/contour-tabs.nc` is byte-for-byte correct.
- The three pins are real. I changed `level_start` to return `seated` (the old behaviour) and all three failed:
  `keep-down ramp, arc lead: window 0 enters at Point2 { x: 46.0, y: 8.864648809967377 }, not at the untabbed start Point2 { x: 43.5138190364642, y: -5.80188731453491 }`.
  I restored the file and the sha256 matches the reviewed file.

## Requested before merge

1. **PR body, last line: change `Fixes #3453` to `Refs #3453`.** This PR is part 1 of #3453 by its own body and by `docs/decisions/3453-tabbed-contour-entry.md`. The issue's "Done means" also asks that every level enter at most one stepdown below the floor (#3678, open) and that `verify` or the notes name a deeper plunge (#3679, open). The body also says tab hops are unchanged, and that is another symptom in #3453. `Fixes` closes the issue on merge while those criteria stay open. AGENTS.md "Pull Request Law" says that partial work uses `Refs #N`.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- The exception keeps the old entry on a ring that shares a level and on every fence band (`PreparedBand::room`), so a tabbed whole-model contour still enters as before. The body and the decision note this, and #3678 owns it. It is correct to leave it out of this PR.
- The committed `contour-tabs.camproj` is version 77 and main writes 78. The loader steps a v77 file up, and `catalog --check` ignores the cached project, so this is harmless. A merge-time refresh would write 78.
- `level_start` overrides the axis start and the lead-room reseat of the untabbed ring. The tabbed window 0 already enters at that point under the same legal room, so the lead is the same one the tabbed level uses. The `contour_start` and `lead_room` suites stay green.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
